## Dire Flytrap (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 N Huge plant  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** blindsense 60 ft; Perception +14  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 7, flat-footed 18 (-1 Dex, +11 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 117 (9d8+45)  
 **Fort** +10, **Ref** +2, **Will** +5  
 **Immune** electricity, plant traits  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 10 ft.  
 **Melee** 4 slam +14 (2d6+7 plus grab), bite +8 (2d6+3)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 90 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 25, **Dex** 8, **Con** 19, **Int** 1, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 6  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 16 (cannot be tripped)  
 **Feats** Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor, Improved Natural Attack (slam), Weapon Focus (slam), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Perception +14  

**Special Abilities**

 **Grab (Ex)**  A dire fly trap can pull grappled creatures toward its mouth at a rate of 15 ft. per round.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests, hills, plains, and rivers  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** normal
